label: Timothy Gallaudet
narrative: Gallaudet is the flag officer who put the safety-of-flight coverup into the congressional record in the first person. Testifying before the joint House Oversight subcommittees on 13 November 2024, he described a January 2015 email from the operations officer of US Fleet Forces Command to all subordinate commanders with the subject line 'URGENT SAFETY OF FLIGHT ISSUE.' The email carried the GO FAST video and, in Gallaudet's account, asked: 'If any of you know what these are, tell me ASAP. We are having multiple near-midair collisions, and if we do not resolve it soon, we will have to shut down the exercise.' The next day, he testified, the email disappeared from his account and from other recipients' accounts without explanation. His conclusion in sworn written testimony is the sharpest available statement of the mechanism: the information 'must have been classified within a special access program managed by an intelligence agency.' This is the single most useful witness account on the board for the question of authority, because it describes not a leak or a rumour but an administrative action taken against an official Navy safety communication - a recall of a fleet-wide flight-safety warning. Gallaudet was Commander, Naval Meteorology and Oceanography Command in 2015, later Oceanographer of the Navy, then Assistant Secretary of Commerce and acting NOAA Administrator.
